question: What baselines do they compare with?

answer.free_form_answer: They compare with the following models: by Pedersen (2017), by Pramanick and Das (2017), by Mikhalkova and Karyakin (2017),  by Vadehra (2017), Indurthi and Oota (2017), by Vechtomova (2017), by (Cai et al., 2018), and CRF.

title: Joint Detection and Location of English Puns
answer_short: CRF model with POS tags, n-grams, label transitions, word suffixes, and relative position features; rule-based locator from BIBREF25 using eleven heuristics
answer_rationale: The baselines compared include a CRF model with features such as POS tags, n-grams, label transitions, word suffixes, and relative position to the end of the text (Text 1). Additionally, a rule-based locator from BIBREF25, which uses eleven heuristics, is mentioned as a baseline (Text 1 and Text 4). These are explicitly stated as the baselines against which the proposed model is evaluated.
